facts.claim: In 1837 no bridge or road worthy of the name existed in the district.
facts.quote: In 1837 not a bridge had been constructed in the District, nor a road formed worthy of the name

facts.claim: The district now has several main roads connecting important towns and facilitating trade with Bangalore, Mysore, Bellary and Mangalore.
facts.quote: But now the District is intersected by several main lines of road, which connect all the towns of any importance, and afford easy means of communication with the large towns of Bangalore, Mysore, Bellary and Mangalore, to which places the trade of the country chiefly converges

facts.claim: There are 127 miles of provincial roads in the district, maintained at a cost of Rs. 23,120 per year.
facts.quote: There are 1 2 7 miles of Provincial roads in the District, maintained at a cost of Rs. 23,120 a year
